ideas.pitch: An onboard computer vision and control pipeline that guides a custom-built drone through 5 circular rings at varying heights without manual intervention.
ideas.title: AeroGate Vision: Autonomous Ring Navigation & Trajectory Optimization
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly automates the core mechanical requirement of Round 1 of the competition, replacing manual piloting with deterministic edge CV to ensure high-speed, flawless ring traversal.

ideas.pitch: A precision landing and obstacle avoidance feedback system ensuring the drone lands within the designated scoring zone to avoid failed landing disqualifications.
ideas.title: PrecisionLanding & Scoring Gatekeeper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on the strict landing and failure penalties outlined in the flight rules, securing points where other manually piloted drones might fail at the finish.

ideas.pitch: A low-latency telemetry and flight diagnostics web dashboard that monitors custom drone health, IMU orientation, and battery metrics during the 8-minute flight window.
ideas.title: KineticTelemetry: Real-Time Drone Flight Diagnostics Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides judges with deep technical visibility into the custom-built drone's internal state, matching the hardware-diagnostics winning pattern seen at hardware hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An auxiliary hardware cutoff and fail-safe radio module that overrides manual controls during unstable flight paths or lost signal scenarios.
ideas.title: FailSafe-Link: Jam-Resilient Emergency Drone Recovery Module
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses safety and reliability concerns explicitly highlighted in the flight and conduct rules, demonstrating rigorous engineering for custom hardware.

ideas.pitch: An optimized state estimation algorithm using sensor fusion (IMU, barometer, and optical flow) to tightly control altitude variations between 1 meter and 2.5 meters.
ideas.title: RingTrack: Multi-Height Kalman Filter State Estimator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the specific physical challenge of maintaining stable flight across varying ring heights, showcasing elite control systems engineering suitable for a multirotor competition.
